تمتدحون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَدِحُونَ (tamtadiḥūna) /tam.ta.di.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# تُمْتَدَحُونَ (tumtadaḥūna) /tum.ta.da.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
